facts.fact: The government's press office reports that on 9 November 2026 the Treasury presented the SIGEF civil-servant management project, with Moroccan firm M2M, including a proposed multiservice card for public employees with robust authentication functions.

GNQ.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No national ID enrolment count stated.
Nothing on ID numbers at birth.
The system named is a civil-servant register, not the national ID system.
The planned civil-servant register has its own biometric identification; no register keyed on a national ID number is stated.
The biometric register covers state employees only, not a national ID system.
